brh2en.src: و کنا لمہ باوہ کنے اجازت تفیسہ۔
brh2en.ref: And my mom and dad will not allow me.
brh2en.hyp: And my parents won't give me permission.

brh2en.src: تینا حالیت ئے داخس دباؤ ٹی انتئے شاغسہ؟
brh2en.ref: Why pushing oneself into such a condition?
brh2en.hyp: Why are you putting yourself under so much pressure?

brh2en.src: بادشاہ زو ئس حکم تس کہ کُل جرنیلاک زو ئس فوج رادہ کبو۔
brh2en.ref: Emperor Ling of Han hastily issued an edict, ordering all generals to send troops immediately to relieve the urgent needs of the court.
brh2en.hyp: The emperor quickly ordered that all the generals should quickly prepare their armies.

brh2en.src: اونا خن تیٹی خڑینک آک بسور ہرا وخت کہ اودے پارے۔
brh2en.ref: His eyes were filled with tears while he was telling her.
brh2en.hyp: Tears came to his eyes when she told him.

brh2en.src: شام نا علاقہ ٹی مخلوق سُو ہم شاغک تے.
brh2en.ref: In the levant they stuff it with meat as well.
brh2en.hyp: In the Syria region, there are also creatures called Suu.

brh2en.src: <یونگ:> انت نی اوڑان ارفینگ کیسہ کہ انت اونا کمرہ ٹی پین ہم بندغ رہینگک؟
brh2en.ref: <yong:> Could you do me a favor to ask her if she has any other roommates?
brh2en.hyp: <Yong:> Do you know whether there are other people staying in his room?

brh2en.src: دا بیریفنگ نا ظاہری عجلت و دا خورتی نا نیام اٹ تضاد پاش ئس ہراڑتون ڈیان، ساڑی مننگ آن زرس ہچکچاہٹ آن باوجود، تینا پُچ و زیور آتے بیناسس تانکہ ہموڑے مخلوق نا تنقید ئے بڑزا کننگ کے۔
brh2en.ref: The contrast couldn't be starker between the apparent improvisation of this decoration and the painstaking attention Diane, despite her reluctance to take part in the event, had paid to arrange the clothes and jewelry which would be sure to provoke the sharp criticism of society members thus gathered.
brh2en.hyp: The apparent haste of the dressing and the contrast between them was evident, in which Diane, despite some hesitation about being there, had worn her gown and jewelry so as to raise the criticism of the people there.

brh2en.src: نن درمیانہ جوانو اسٹیک آرڈر کرین، ولے دا تو بھاز گچین مس۔
brh2en.ref: We ordered a medium rare steak, but it was well done.
brh2en.hyp: We ordered a medium steak, but it turned out to be very good.

brh2en.src: <کمنٹ 3:> تعریف نا قابل! اندن لگک کہ دا زندہ اے۔
brh2en.ref: <comment 3:>  Impressive!  Almost like it is alive.
brh2en.hyp: <Comment 3:> Praiseworthy! It looks like it's alive.

brh2en.src: <A:> حیرانی نا ہیت ئس اے کہ نن تون کس مشورہ کتو، نن واقعی بھاز لائخ اون
brh2en.ref: <A:> It's astonishing that no one asks us for advice, we are so smart indeed
brh2en.hyp: <A:> It's surprising that no one has consulted us, we're really worthy.

brh2en.src: پٹاٹہ نا پکوڑا جوڑ کننگ نا اندنو وڑ ئس ہراکے ہچ ناکام مفک
brh2en.ref: Tips for making fail-proof potato fritters
brh2en.hyp: A potato fritter recipe that never fails

brh2en.src: <A:> بَش اوس؟
brh2en.ref: <A:>You up?
brh2en.hyp: <A:> Are you getting up?

brh2en.src: ژانگ جیاؤ الس اٹ پھیلائنگوکا ناجوڑی تیان فائدہ ارفے، تینے حکیم ئس نشان تس و بغاوت کن الس ئے مُچ کرے۔
brh2en.ref: Zhang Jiao took advantage of the plague among the plebs, he claimed he could cure diseases and ask his believers to gather and revolt.
brh2en.hyp: Zhang Jiao took advantage of the illness spreading among the people, presented himself as a healer, and gathered the people for rebellion.

brh2en.src: تینا اورانا چپ و چاگڑد ٹی دیر مُچ مننگ الپابو تانکہ زیات پَشّہ ودی مف۔
brh2en.ref: Don't let water collect around the house, so that there are not too many mosquitoes.
brh2en.hyp: Avoid water collecting around your house so that more mosquitoes don't breed.

brh2en.src: ای داسہ نیکن رائی کیوہ تا۔
brh2en.ref: I will send it to you right now.
brh2en.hyp: I will show you now.

brh2en.src: اوکان پد ای ہائیڈ پارک گام خلیسہ بگ بین اسکان سر مسوٹ، کسر ٹی بکنہم پیلس ہم تدینگا۔
brh2en.ref: After that I walked in Hyde Park until I reached Big Ben, I passed Buckingham Palace on my way there.
brh2en.hyp: After that I walked through Hyde Park and reached Big Ben, with Buckingham Palace also seen along the way.

brh2en.src: موبائل پلے بیک: کنکشن آن گُڈ فون نا میوزک پلیئر ئے ملیسہ شیئر چلیفبو۔
brh2en.ref: Mobile playback: After successfully connecting to Bluetooth, open the music player on your mobile phone to play music.
brh2en.hyp: Mobile playback: After connecting, open the phone's music player and start playing to share.

brh2en.src: نم دا وردش آتے کننگ کیرے: بیڈی تے بڑزا کننگ، اسکیپنگ، دُو تے چرخ تننگ، جمپ خلنگ، 4-گام تیز نرنگ، چپی نرنگ، یا پالو بدل کرسہ نرنگ نا وردشاک۔
brh2en.ref: You can choose among the following exercises: knee raises, skipping, arm rotations, hopping, 4-step accelerations, running backwards, or even direction changes.
brh2en.hyp: You can do these exercises: raising your knees high, skipping, circling your arms, jumping, 4-step fast running, side running, or alternating-side running exercises.

brh2en.src: سد سالہ اواری؛ اُست ہمشہ کن گنڈوک مریک
brh2en.ref: A hundred years of harmony; hearts united forever
brh2en.hyp: A hundred years together; the heart is joyful forever.

brh2en.src: انداڑتون دروازہ نا گھنٹی لگا، وہرا وخت کہ او پیشن ہورا تو اوڑے کس الو۔
brh2en.ref: Just then, the doorbell rang, and he saw that there was no one outside.
brh2en.hyp: Just then the doorbell rang, but when he went outside there was nobody there.

brh2en.src: نن ملک ٹی بھاز وخت مخلوق ئے ہمو قانون آتا معلومداری اف ہراکے اوفتا حفاظت کن مریک۔
brh2en.ref: In our country, we sometimes don't know the laws that protect people.
brh2en.hyp: In our country, people often do not know about the laws that exist for their protection.
